name: waggle
description: Local graph memory that lets Codex recall project context across sessions.

interface.longDescription: Waggle gives Codex local graph memory for project decisions, constraints, preferences, and outcomes across sessions. It runs as a bundled MCP server with SQLite storage, so memory stays on your machine unless you explicitly export or sync it. Website: wagglemcp.vercel.app. Demo: youtu.be/6z5ALzqvtIY.
defaultPrompt: Remember: Magic Ball chose SQLite so demos work offline.
